gadievron-raptor-audit.description: Hypothesis-driven, tool-grounded security review of coverage gaps

gadievron-raptor-crash-analysis-gcov-cov.description: Add gcov code coverage instrumentation to C/C++ projects
gadievron-raptor-crash-analysis-gcov-cov.author: Claude

gadievron-raptor-code-understanding.description: Provides adversarial code comprehension for security research, mapping architecture, tracing data flows, and hunting vulnerability variants to build ground-truth understanding before or alongside static analysis.

gadievron-raptor-exploitability-validati.description: Multi-stage pipeline for validating that vulnerability findings are real, reachable, and exploitable, preventing wasted effort on hallucinated findings, dead code paths, or findings with unrealistic preconditions.

gadievron-raptor-frida.description: Dynamic instrumentation via Frida - attach to or spawn a process, load a JS hook script, capture send() events into a lifecycle-managed run directory. Supports local, USB-attached, and remote frida-server targets.

gadievron-raptor-crash-analysis-function.description: Instrument C/C++ with -finstrument-functions for execution tracing and Perfetto visualisation
gadievron-raptor-crash-analysis-function.author: Claude

gadievron-raptor-oss-forensics-github-ar.description: Investigate GitHub security incidents using tamper-proof GitHub Archive data via BigQuery. Use when verifying repository activity claims, recovering deleted PRs/branches/tags/repos, attributing actions to actors, or reconstructing attack timelines. Provides immutable forensic evidence of all public GitHub events since 2011.
gadievron-raptor-oss-forensics-github-ar.author: mbrg

gadievron-raptor-oss-forensics-github-co.description: Recover deleted commits from GitHub using REST API, web interface, and git fetch. Use when you have commit SHAs and need to retrieve actual commit content, diffs, or patches. Includes techniques for accessing "deleted" commits that remain on GitHub servers.
gadievron-raptor-oss-forensics-github-co.author: mbrg

gadievron-raptor-oss-forensics-github-ev.description: Generate, export, load, and verify forensic evidence from GitHub sources. Use when creating verifiable evidence objects from GitHub API, GH Archive, Wayback Machine, local git repositories, or security vendor reports. Handles evidence storage, querying, and re-verification against original sources.
gadievron-raptor-oss-forensics-github-ev.author: mbrg

gadievron-raptor-oss-forensics-github-wa.description: Recover deleted GitHub content using the Wayback Machine and Archive.org APIs. Use when repositories, files, issues, PRs, or wiki pages have been deleted from GitHub but may persist in web archives. Covers CDX API queries, URL patterns, and systematic recovery workflows.
gadievron-raptor-oss-forensics-github-wa.author: mbrg

gadievron-raptor-crash-analysis-line-exe.description: Check if specific lines were executed using gcov data
gadievron-raptor-crash-analysis-line-exe.author: Claude

gadievron-raptor-oss-forensics-orchestra.description: Orchestrates multi-agent forensic investigations on public GitHub repositories, coordinating parallel evidence collection, hypothesis formation, verification, and report generation.

gadievron-raptor-crash-analysis-rr-debug.description: Deterministic debugging with rr record-replay. Use when debugging crashes, ASAN faults, or when reverse execution is needed. Provides reverse-next, reverse-step, reverse-continue commands and crash trace extraction.
